tei:div.tei:p: 1)༄༅/ gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha snyan brgyud zab mo'i skor las bla ma drag po badz+ra ki la ya'i phrin las dngos grub char 'bebs bzhugs/ 2)༄༅/

rgyal kun spyi gzugs pad+ma 'byung*// gdul dka'i 'gro la rab khros pa// dbang drag badz+ra ki la ya// dbyer med bla ma rje la 'dud// gang gi sgrub thabs bdud rtsi'i skyes// zab rgu'i gdams pa'i snying po 'di// brjod bde'i ngag khrigs bsdebs pa la// lha dang bla mas gnang ba stsol// 'di la gsum ste/ sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes so/ dang po la yo byad 'du bya ba dang cho ga'i sbyor ba'o/ dang po ni/ dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa'i sngags pas dur khrod la sogs te dben pa'i gnas su sku gsung thugs kyi rten bkram/ rgyan dang spyan gzigs du mas mdzes par byas/ gzhung las/ dkyil 'khor gtor ma dpe ris ltar: thig bcas bris la rten du bzhag: rgyun bsnyen la ni med kyang chog: ces pas sgrub pa'i dus su dkyil 'khor sgo bzhi mtshan nyid rdzogs pa sbrul gyis brgyan pa mthar rdo rwa dang lcags sdig gi rwa bas bskor ba bris pa'i dbus su mañdzi'i khar gtor ma mchod rten gyi dbyibs la mas nas bang rim gsum steng zlum bskor/ de steng bang rim gnyis dang*/ de steng yas man pad+ma grog rked gnyis brtsegs bar mu khyud dang bcas pa/ de steng dmar gtor zur gsum pad phreng nor bu sogs kyis brgyan pa sman raka nyer spyod tshogs gtor sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad mtha' dag bsham mo/ gnyis pa la/ thog 3) mar bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ e ma ho: kun bzang rigs lnga rdo rje 'chang chen po: rdzogs chen ston pa bcu gnyis rdor sems so gas: rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla mar gsol ba 'debs: gdod ma'i gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs: dga' rab rdo rje shrī seng ha dang: rgya gar rig 'dzin brgyad dang mkha' spyod kyi: rig 'dzin lnga dang gu ru pad+ma 'byung: rig 'dzin brda brgyud kun la= 'ja' lus 'chi med 'grub par byin gyis= rje 'bangs nyer lnga gter ston brgya rtsa sogs:

chos bdag gang zag snyan brgyud bla ma la: gsol ba 'debs so chos nyid zad phyin shog: gu ru zhi drag bka' dgongs phur gsumadang: phag khros seng gsum zhi khro rab 'byams sogs: yi dam lha tshogs kun la= mchog thun dngos grub myur thob byin= ma ning sde lnga 'bar ma seng gdong dang: dzaṃ la rigs lnga nor rgyun mched lnga sogs: chos skyong gter bdag rnams la= ci bsam thams cad yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod: de ltar bdag gis gsol ba btab pa'i mthus: tshe dang sgrub pa ma lus mthar phyin nas: 4)tshe 'dir sangs rgyas 'grub par byin gyis brlobs: de nas skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ tshogs zhing mkha' khyab tu sad par bsam la/ na:mo dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum: skyabs gnas rnams la skyabs su mchi: sems bskyed pa ni/ 'gro kun sangs rgyas la 'god phyir: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: skyabs sems sbrel nas lan gsum/ yan lag brgyad pa ni/ hūm̐: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la: dkar gsum mngar gsum bdud rtsis mchod: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la: sdig sgrib nyams chag thams cad bshags: dge bsod kun la rjes yi rang: chos kyis 'khor lo bskor bar 'tshal: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs: 'gro ba sems can ma lus pa: kun tu bzang po'i sa thob shog: zhes pas rgyud dag par byas nas tshogs zhing rang la bsdu/ rang nyid gnyug ma'i lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas sngon gtor bshams la/ rin chen snod du gtor ma ni: bdud rtsir gyur cig oṃ ā hūm̐: byin gyis brlabs/ gnyug gnas glo bur lhags pa yi: gnas 5)bdag gzhi bdag 'byung po'i tshogs: 'dir 'dus mchod sbyin gtor ma bzhes: gnas 'dir gsang sngags bsgrub pa la: ru nga phrag dog ma byed bar: dkar phyogs sdong grogs mthun rkyen sgrubs:

nag phyogs bgegs rigs gzhan du dengs: gal te mi nyan 'tshe byed na: ye shes khro bos brlag par 'gyur: de bas sgo ba'i bka' la nyon: oṃ sarba lo ka pā la ba ling ta khā hi khā hi: sarba gtsa tshad gats+tsha : ces gtor ma bsngos te bka' bsgo ba ni/ hūm̐: nga ni khro bo dbang chen te: bgegs dang log 'dren nga la nyon: nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed: nga yi bka' las 'da' byed na: bdag nyid nga rgyal thugs khros te: thal ba'i rdul du brlag par byed: de bas da lta phyir dengs shig: oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha sogs drag sngags spos rol dang bcas pas bgegs bskrad nas mtshams bcad pa ni/ hūm̐: nga ni dbang drag ki la ya'i: thugs kar gser gyi ga'u'i nang: bdag cag dpon slob bsrung bya tshud: steng 'og rdo rje'i gur sar gyur: oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: dam bca' ba ni/ hūm̐ ma 'grub bar du dkyil 'khor mi 6)gtong na: yi dam drag po'i lha tshogs ma lus rnams: srog la bab kyang bdag gis gzung bar bgyi: bdag gis dam tshig gtong bar mi bgyid do: byin dbab pa ni/ spos rol g.yab dar gdung dbyangs bcas pas/ hūm̐: dbang drag kī la ya yi lha tshogs rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen dbab tu gsol: skal ldan dad ldan bdag la dbang mchog bskur: log 'dren tshe yi bar chad bsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra ā we sha ya a: mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni/ ka dag klong nas sprul pa yi: gnam sa gang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin: sman gtor rak+ta lha mor bcas: zad med gyur cig pū+u dza ho: oṃ āḥm hā pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrī:thāḥ oṃ āḥm hā ba liṃ ta hūm̐ hrī:thā: oṃ āḥm hā rak+ṣa hum̐ hrī:thā: oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe.a lo ke gan+dhe nai wi ng+ya shab+da āḥhūm̐: rgyun bshags bya ba ni/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad dang: chos skyong nor lha kun gyi thugs dang ni: 'gal bar gyur pa ma lus ci mchis pa: bdag gis gnong zhing 'gyod pas mthol lo bshags:

badz+ra sa ma 7)ya shud+dhe āḥ de dag ni sngon 'gro'i las kyi rim pa'o/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la lha bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: chos rnams thams cad rang gi sems las byung: sems nyid ye nas stong pa nyid kyi ngang: sems can kun gyi de don ma rtogs pas: 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i sems can snying re rje: chos rnams thams cad rten 'brel rgyu las byung: hūm̐ ni+e rgyu yi sa bon nyid du gsal: de las ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gsum 'phros pa yis: ram̐ gyi mes bsregs yam̐ gyi rlung gis gtor: khaṃ gyi chus bkrus stong pa nyid du brdal: e yam̐ kham̐ gsum bh+rum̐ gyi yi ge yi: rang byung 'byung ba chen po lnga chags te: mkha' rlung chu dang ri rab gser gyi gzhi: de steng bh+rum̐ gyi yi ge las bskyed pa'i: gzhal yas khang ni sgo gru rta babs rdzogs: gdugs tog chos 'khor ri dwags pad 'dab mtshan: rdo ra ye shes lnga yi mai ri 'bar: bh+rum̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe e dzñā na tsakra maṇ+ḍal bhūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las gur drag phur mjug can: zhal bzhi phyogs bzhir bltas nas rgyal 'gong 'dul: phyag bzhi dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang: sdig 8)pa 'dzin te 'og gnyis gri kha ṭ+wām̐: sku smad phur pa dbal dang ldan pa ni: rgyal bsen snying gar dbal mi thub par zug: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis ye shes pa spyan drangs: dbang lha rnams kyis dbang bskur rigs bdag mtshan: de yi thugs kar hūm̐ la sngags g.yas bskor: sngags de drag tu 'khor bas 'grub par 'gyur: 'od 'phros zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo nas: gur drag dpag med spyan drangs sib sib thim: spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: sku gsum rtsa rgyud bla ma spyan 'dren no: yi dam lha tshogs ma lus spyan 'dren no: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kun ma lus spyan 'dren no: chos skyong nor lha grogs mdzad spyan 'dren no: badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: zhes rol mo dbyangs dang bcas ste spyan drangs/ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/

hūm̐: sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba'i gdan steng du: rtsa rgyud bla ma ma lus bzhugs su gsol: nyi zla pad+ma brjid pa'i gdan steng du: yi dam lha tshogs ma lus bzhugs su gsol: sna tshogs rin chen pad+ma'i gdan steng du: mkha' 'gro thams cad dgyes par bzhugs su sol: pad+ma nyi ma bam ro'i gdan steng du: chos skyong 9)srung ma thams cad bzhugs su gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad dang: chos skyong nor lha dam can rgya mtsho la: bdag gis rab tu gus pas dwangs ba yis: lus ngag yid gsum dad pas phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang: nor lha dam can gter bdag thams cad la: mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos dang: mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo 'bul: gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim ro mngar dang: reg bya 'jam pa bdag gis mchod pa 'bul: ye shes lnga yi bdud rtsi chen po dang: ba ling gtor ma'i zhal zas brjid pa dang: khams gsum bsgral ba'i rak+ta mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs kyi rig ma dkar dmar mthing: shin tu mdzes shing blta na sdug pa la: rin chen dar zab mang po'i rgyan gyis brgyan: rtsa ba gsum la bdag gis mchod pa 'bul: log 'dren dgra bgegs bstan la gnod byed rnams: chos kyi 10)dbyings su bdag gis bsgral byas te: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul: ar+ghaṃ pad+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhub pai a lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ya shap+da ru pa shab+da gan+dhe ra sa spar+she a mṛ ta ba liṃ ta rak+ta mu dre ma traṃ rū tra pra we sha ya kha kha khā hi khā hi: bstod pa ni/ hūṃ: dad ldan bu la byin rlabs char 'bebs pa'i: bla ma'i lha tshogs kun la bstod par bgyi: dngos grub ma lus lhun gyis sgrub mdzad pa'i: yi dam kun la bdag gis bstod par bgyi: 'gro ba snang srid dbang du sdud mdzad pa'i: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bdag gis bstod par bgyi:

bstan pa srung ba'i las la rab tu brtson: chos skyong kun la bdag gis bstod par bgyi: dgos 'dod re ba skong bar mdzad pa yis: nor lha'i tshogs la bdag gis bstod par bgyi: bstan la gnod byed bsgral bar mdzad pa yi: dam can tshogs la bdag gis bstod par bgyi: bshags pa ni/ hūṃ: bla ma rnams la 'byor tshogs chung ba bshags: yi dam lha la spong len byas pa bshags: mkha' 'gro rnams la gsang ba bsgrags pa bshags: chos skyong rnams la 11)mchod gtor chung ba bshags: tshangs pa chen po'i dngos grub stsal du gsol: yig brgya bzla/ dzab dmigs ni/ bdag gi thugs kar hūm̐ la sngags g.yas bskor: sngags de drag tu 'khor bas 'grub par gyur: oṃ artsika ne rtsika na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa: rtags mthong nas las sbyor smyo 'dul gyi sngags dmigs ni/ rang nyid gu ru drag por bsam: rang gi me yi tshwa tshwa las: rang 'dra'i gu ru drag po re: gdon bgegs rgyal bsen mi tshugs bsamaḥ gzugs rnams thams cad gur drag bsam: sgra rnams thams cad drag sngags bsam: gnod byaid rgyal bsen mi tshugs bsam: rtsa sngags gsham du/ badz+ra mṛ ta: badz+ra su mṛ ta: badz+ra ho ra mṛ ta: badz+ra hūm̐ mṛ ta: badza rak+ṣa mṛ ta: badz+ra ma mṛ ta: badz+ra k+ṣa mṛ ta: badz+ra yaṃ mṛ ta: badz+ra dhi mṛ ta: badz+ra mṛ ta mri ta ye swa hā: grangs bsnyen 'bum phrag nyi shu bzla// mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa rtags mthong bar// dus kyi bsnyen pa zla ba gnyis// smin slob bzhi 'gyur bzlas pas 'grub// las sbyor bsnyen pa bcu cha'o// de ni dngos gzhi'i las rim mo/ / 12) gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la/ tshogs rdzas 'byor tshod bshams shing byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: raṃ las me 'phros dngos 'dzin bsregs: yaṃ las rlung 'phros bag chags gtor: khaṃ las chu byung gnyis 'dzin bkrus: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ:oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum 'od du zhu:

bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing gar gyur: tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: sku gsum rtsa rgyud bla ma rnams: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: yi dam lha chogs ma lus pa: tshogs la= mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs ma lus pa: tshogs la= chos skyong srung ma ma lus pa: tshogs la= nor lha dam can rgya mtsho rnams: tshogs= tshogs gtor 'di la byin gyis rlobs: rnal 'byor bsam pa 'grub tu gsol: tshogs phud cha gsum spros la dang po mchod pa ni/ rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhes su gsol: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsol: bar pa bshags pa 'bul zhing*/ thugs dang 'gal bar gyur pa bshags: tha ma bsgral dmigs bcas 13) pas bstab la/ dam sri gnod byed zhal du bstab: gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki ni: ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: sngags lan gsum/ tshogs la rol pa ni/ las rdor gyi tshogs btegs la/ ho/ tshogs kyi mchod pa rgyun du rol/ zhes drang*/ slob dpon gyis/ a la la ho/ zhes rtse gsum dang pad+ma'i phyag rgyas blangs te tshim par rol/ lhag gtor ni/ lhag ma rnams bsdus la slob dpon gyi kha phru btab nas byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za dur bdag mo: lhag la dbang ba'i 'byung po gtor len rnams: lhag ma 'di bzhes gnod byed dgra bgegs rnams: thams cad rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: u tsiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes phyi rol du bskyal/ thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang: gzugs sku 'jigs pa'i cha lugs rdzogs mdzad pa: rig 'dzin yi dam ḍāka'i chos skyong tshogs: mi mngon dbyings nas gnas 'dir sku bskyod la: zhal gdangs mche gcigs skan sgra chems se chem: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: chad mdo ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma yi:

14) lha srin dam la btags pa rnams: sngon gyi dam bca' ma g.yel bar: brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: brtan ma bcu gnyis dam la btags: bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar: brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ma ma hriṃ hriṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi khā hi: bro rdung ba ni/ hrī: khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog dpal: dbang chen rngams pa'i sgra sgrog cing: dpal gyi rta skad tse re re: khro bo'i 'brug sgra di ri ri: rol ba'i rta bro chems se chem: bdud dang dam sri rdul du rlogs: oṃ hrīḥpad+man+ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha h+ya gṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ laṃ ham̐'u laṃ staṃ bha ya nan: rjes chog mchod bstod ni / oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ= shab+da pra tīts+tsha ā:ham̐'u: ma hā pañtsa rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi: hūm̐: rang byung lhun grub pad+ma 'byung gnas sku: dus gsum sangs rgyas sku gsung thugs las sprul: mthu rtsal rmad byung pad+ma he ru ka: lha srin drag po 'dul ba'i stobs 15)mnga' ba: dbang drag pad+ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:

dngos grub blang ba ni/ hrī: 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs zhi ba'i dngos grub stsol: 'byor pa drug ldan rgyas pa'i= mos pa rnam bzhi dbang gi= dgra bgegs tshar gcod drag po'i= las bzhi lhun gyis grub pa'i= bde stong phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub stsol: mchog dang thun mong gnyis kyi dngos grub stsol: gu ru de ba ḍāki ni kā ya wāka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la a la la ho: bzod par gsol ba ni/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang*// gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas// 'dir ni bgyi ba gang nongs pa// de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ yig brgya bzla/ brtan bzhugs ni/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu// 'khor ba srid du bzhugs nas kyang*// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swa hā/ sprul pa bsdu ba ni/ snang srid ma lus rang gi sku la bsdu: rang nyid thugs ka'i sngags 'khor la thim nas: de yang de dbus hūm̐ dang hrīḥl thim: ham̐'u dang hrīḥyang mi dmigs nam mkha' ltar: slar yang dran rig ma hā gu ru'i skur gyur: dge bsngo ni/ 16)dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /he ru ka dpal 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog bkra shis brjod pa ni/ hūm̐: sku gsum bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog: yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog: mkha' 'grochos skyong nor lha'i bkra shis shog: gter srung dam can rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog: zhes bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa rgya cher brjod par bya'o// ma rung nyams pa'i srog gi gshed// rgyal 'gong dam sri'i gnyen po che// dam ldan sgrub la dngos grub dbyig /'bad med stsol ba'i phrin las can// bla ma drag po kī la yas// skye dang skye bar rjes bzung zhing*// gsang chen rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mjing*/ thos bsam sgom pas 'dzin nus shog zhes pa'ang gter gzhung gtsang dag la med thabs med pa'i zur 'debs kyis brgyan te bklag chog tu bkod pa 'di yang 'jam dpal grub pa'i blo gros so/// /
